# Review CHANGES REQUESTED for PAN-5468

# Review — PAN-5468
## Verdict: CHANGES REQUESTED — page claims a failed UAT verdict "always blocks merge, on any project"; the gate only blocks it while the issue is held for UAT

## Context
- Run ID: agent-pan-5468-review-7b61af3e
- Manifest: /home/eltmon/Projects/overdeck/workspaces/feature-pan-5468/.pan/review/agent-pan-5468-review-7b61af3e/context.json
- Branch / workspace: feature/pan-5468 / /home/eltmon/Projects/overdeck/workspaces/feature-pan-5468
- PR: https://github.com/eltmon/overdeck/pull/5538 (open, not draft, head 7b61af3e)
- HEAD reviewed: 7b61af3e1014e090ad09b71dab740d518ca18059

## Blocking Findings

### [correctness] Failed UAT described as an unconditional merge block — `features/issue-pipeline.mdx:83`
- Severity: ! (MUST)
- Classification / requirement scope: implementation defect (page wording goes beyond the PRD), with a related spec defect in the PRD's merge-gate list; in_pr_scope.
- Trigger and changed-code connection: the new page's Tests and UAT section says: "A failed UAT verdict at the PR head always blocks merge, on any project: it is treated as evidence the code does not work." The Merge section (line 115) also lists "there is no failed UAT verdict at the head" as an unconditional gate condition.
- Expected / observed / impact: in code, `evaluateIssueMergeGate` (`src/lib/cloister/merge-gate.ts:155-163`) sets `uatRequired` only through `defaultUatRequired` → `issueHoldsForUat` → `shouldHoldForUat` (`src/lib/cloister/auto-merge-policy.ts:17-27`). `evaluateMergeReadiness` (`src/lib/cloister/pr-facts.ts:971`) blocks on a failed UAT only `if (policy.uatRequired && ...)`, and its policy doc (`pr-facts.ts:906-910`) says so: "UAT is required for the issue (... `auto-merge` / `hold-for-uat` label, else the project's `auto_merge_default`, else the global `flywheel.require_uat_before_merge`), so a failed UAT verdict at the current head blocks the merge." So an issue labelled `auto-merge`, or in a project with `auto_merge_default: auto`, or with the global hold turned off, merges through a failed UAT verdict. Those are exactly the auto-merge cases where no person is watching. The page states the opposite as a safety guarantee ("always ... on any project"), so an operator who turns on auto-merge relying on this page is misled about what protects them. This page is docs-only; its whole value is accuracy, and this is the one claim about a merge safety property.
- Evidence: static trace of `merge-gate.ts:99-107,155-165`, `auto-merge-eligibility.ts:130-146`, `auto-merge-policy.ts:17-27`, `pr-facts.ts:906-972`. The PRD (`.pan/drafts/PAN-5468.md`, Tests and UAT background) says only "A failed UAT verdict at the PR head blocks merge"; "always, on any project" is the page's own addition. Limitation: not reproduced live; the code path is unambiguous.
- Fix: in Tests and UAT, replace the sentence with something like: "While an issue is held for UAT (the default; see [Merge](#merge)), a failed UAT verdict at the PR head blocks merge: it is treated as evidence the code does not work. With the hold off for that issue, a failed UAT verdict does not block merge." In the Merge section's gate list, qualify the condition the same way ("no failed UAT verdict at the head while the issue is held for UAT"). Spec correction: the PRD's merge-gate bullet ("no failed UAT verdict at the head") should carry the same qualifier.

## Non-blocking Findings

1. **~ At-a-glance row contradicts the page's own Tests section** — `features/issue-pipeline.mdx:20`. Implementation defect. The row says Tests and UAT is moved on by "A passed tests verdict and no failed UAT verdict". No merge path requires a passed test-role verdict (`evaluateMergeReadiness` has no such check; in CI mode it requires the CI test job, `pr-facts.ts:962`), and the page's own Tests and UAT section says the test role usually does not run today (#5537). Fix: e.g. "In CI mode, the CI test job passes on the head; no failed UAT verdict while held for UAT".

2. **~ `pan sync-main` `.pan/` conflict scope is overstated** — `features/issue-pipeline.mdx:99`. Spec defect copied from the PRD ("Conflicts only in `.pan/` resolve to main"). Code prefers main only for `.pan/continues` and `.pan/specs` (`src/lib/cloister/merge-agent.ts:59-68`, `resolveMainPreferredSyncConflicts` at line 647). A conflict in `.pan/drafts/` aborts for manual resolution. Fix: "A conflict confined to the plan files under `.pan/specs/` and `.pan/continues/` resolves in favor of `main`".

3. **? Needs-you list membership of three escalations is unconfirmed** — `features/issue-pipeline.mdx:57,69,105`. The page says verification-stuck pauses come "with a Needs-you signal", that "Needs you shows `Review loop not converging`" (FR-6 asks for this, so partly a spec claim), and lists "a work agent paused after verification got stuck, a review loop that stopped converging, and a conflict-repair timeout" among Needs-you items. Traced: review-loop and conflict-repair escalations call `surfaceIssueFeedbackNeedsYou` (`src/lib/cloister/feedback-target.ts:344-361`), which only emits an activity-stream warning `"<id> needs you: ..."`; verification-stuck is a non-operator pause (`verification-escalation.ts:99-120`, `setAgentPaused(agentId, reason, true)` with `byOperator=false`). The Needs-you selector (`FE/lib/selectors/needsYou.ts:1-10`) reads pending input, derived `attention: 'needs-you'` (only `pan ask` and blocked panes, `derived-issue-state.ts:217-224`), Flywheel tick-marker rows and decisions. No path from those activity warnings into the top-bar list was found, except possibly through Flywheel rows when a Flywheel run is active. What would settle it: a live check that one of these escalations increments `Needs you · N` without a Flywheel. Suggest softer wording ("is announced as needing you on the activity feed") or confirm and keep.

4. **≉ Label names in the merge-policy sentence** — `features/issue-pipeline.mdx:119`. "the per-issue `Auto` or `Hold` label": the labels are `auto-merge` and `hold-for-uat`; `Auto` / `Hold` is the Awaiting Merge toggle that sets them (`auto-merge-policy.ts`, PRD Merge background). Suggest "the per-issue `auto-merge` or `hold-for-uat` label (the `Auto` / `Hold` toggle)".

5. **≉ `pan reopen` sentence restates the help text D-4 says to drop** — `features/issue-pipeline.mdx:166`. "Its help text claims it clears old specialist fields..." passes AC-13 literally (the banned phrase is absent) but D-4 says the page "never quotes the contradicting help sentence". Paraphrasing it to rebut it is optional noise; consider cutting to the factual clause.

6. **? `close_out.auto` mention vs the close-out-settings non-goal** — `features/issue-pipeline.mdx:145`. The PRD background includes "close_out.auto is inert" but also says to "mention no settings" unless `/features/workspaces` has a close-out section. One sentence saying the old setting is inert is low risk; flagging only so #5479 stays the owner.
